note: Hatchery Heist master creature list: every creature planned for the game, all seven tiers. Proposal written Nov 5 2026 for Alex's approval; builder threads build from this file in batches once approved. Check it with: python3 tools/art/master_list.py
tierCurve: Alex's counts (Common 200, Rare 100, Ultra Rare 75, Legendary 50, Godly 20) with Uncommon and Epic set on the same curve between their neighbours (Alex, Nov 5 11:47Z)

fields.id: CamelCase, at most 24 characters, unique; existing ids never change
fields.status: in-game (in config/creatures.luau), designed (roster data, not in the game yet), rework (in game, model being redone), new (to build)
fields.plan: body plan, with the kind in brackets; plans not in tools/art yet: puff, upright, bat, fish, jelly, octopus, whale, ray, drake, serpent, dino, griffin (hand-built legends today), critter (scorpion)
fields.gait: trot, waddle, hop, scuttle, slither, hover; swim is new (no swim animation yet)
fields.element: Ember, Glacial, Nature, Storm or plain (elements are deferred; the field is set now)
